title: GoldenEye Hotels: Where It Was Filmed
description: Two real hotels from GoldenEye: the Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo and The Langham London, which stood in for a St Petersburg hotel.
h1: GoldenEye hotels: where it was filmed
intro: Pierce Brosnan's first Bond film (1995) was shot in Monaco, Russia, Puerto Rico and the UK. Two of its hotels are real and open to guests today.

hotels.note: GoldenEye's Monaco scenes were filmed at the Monte-Carlo Casino, Port Hercules and the Hôtel de Paris, according to the Monaco Tribune.
The Langham's exterior stood in for the Grand Hotel Europe in St Petersburg, according to Time Out. Interior scenes were not filmed here.

outro: The two hotels are in different countries, so treat them as separate trips: Monaco for the casino square and London for a grand Victorian façade.
